resources.string: The connection is optional; the app works the same without it. With it, the app reads the data of your metering point from the Moj Elektro portal and shows you, in the Consumption tab, your consumption by time block, your 15-minute peaks against the agreed power and, if you have it, the energy you deliver.

The token and EIMM are stored only on this phone, encrypted with a key that never leaves the phone\'s secure storage. The app sends them only to the official Moj Elektro server (api.informatika.si), never to anyone else. The data of your metering point stays on the phone (readings are stored encrypted and deleted when you disconnect). The token is read-only; you can revoke it on mojelektro.si at any time.
Moj Elektro publishes meter data with a delay, usually about one day. The app therefore never shows your current consumption.

Your consumption (Moj Elektro) against the time blocks (uro.si)

The consumption traffic light shows your 15-minute power against the official time blocks, your peaks against the agreed power and your consumption by block. You need an API token from the Moj Elektro portal and your EIMM. Everything stays encrypted on your phone.
1. Create a read-only API token on mojelektro.si.
2. In Settings, choose Moj Elektro connection and paste the token and the EIMM.
3. Come back here: the chart is ready in a few seconds.
The first load can take a few seconds: the app downloads the readings and the official time blocks of every day.

Status codes are added by Moj Elektro (e.g. an estimated or substituted value). Whether a timestamp marks the start or the end of its quarter hour is worked out from the data itself (compared with the daily meter states).

The power agreed for your metering point in each time block. The app reads it from Moj Elektro. The power rate is charged on the agreed (and any exceeded) power in the block, regardless of the kWh used.
How is the power of a quarter hour calculated?
The meter records the energy of every quarter hour in kWh. The average power of that quarter hour is the energy divided by a quarter of an hour (kWh × 4).
Where do the time blocks and colours come from?

For every past day the app asks the official source uro.si which block applied in each hour. No block rules are written into the app. The colours come from the official uro.si table of the current year.
Why is there no data for today?
Moj Elektro publishes readings with a delay, usually about one day. The block in force now is on the first page.
